query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b2b_units u WHERE u.tenant=$1 AND u.id=$2 AND (u.data->>'currency' IS DISTINCT FROM $3::text OR u.data->>'budgetPeriod' IS DISTINCT FROM $4::text) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b2b_budget_allocations b WHERE b.tenant=u.tenant AND b.unit_id=u.id AND NOT b.released)) AS "v!"
